description: This class includes the manufacture of military fighting vehicles, weapons and ammunition.
includes: manufacture of heavy weapons: artillery, mobile guns, rocket launchers, torpedoes, heavy machine guns
manufacture of small arms: revolvers, shotguns, light machine guns, rifles, pistols
manufacture of air or gas guns and pistols
manufacture of ammunition: bombs, mines, torpedoes, grenades, cartridges and other ammunition and projectiles
manufacture of hunting, sporting or protective firearms and ammunition
manufacture of military fighting vehicles: tanks, armed amphibious vehicles, military armoured personnel carriers
manufacture of fireworks and pyrotechnic articles (see also 2029)
excludes: forging, pressing, stamping and roll-forming of metal, see 2591
